reason: internal/cli/version.go is generated and carries the generator's default literal (1.0.0); a reprint resets it. The 2.0.0 release is a breaking one (one Report envelope for every detector inside the provenance envelope, --period defaulting to the current year instead of all history, exit code 8 for a guarded write), so the literal is bumped in place with a PATCH marker and recorded here to make a regeneration fail closed rather than silently ship 1.0.0 again. .goreleaser.yaml injects -X fiken-cli/internal/cli.version at release time, which matches this var; the Makefile injects nothing, so `make build`/`go install` binaries carry exactly this literal. The second goreleaser build (fiken-mcp) injects main.version, whose in-tree default in cmd/fiken-mcp/main.go stays 0.0.0-dev and is not touched here. CHANGELOG.md, previously a three-line header, gains the 2.0.0 section.
validated_outcome: go build ./... and `make check` pass; `fiken-cli version` prints 2.0.0.
